title: ProbeDeepOutput
description: Output of `--probe-deep` (v0.7.3+). CAPTCHA detection with mitigation hints. v1.0.2 adds `deep_research_budget` SSOT snapshot (CM-10). Production path uses Chrome DOM (GAP-WS-113 / ADR-0016). Wire keys: English default (v1.0.2 / ADR-0027); PT aliases accepted on deserialize. v1.0.4 fixed three asymmetries against the `probe-output` sibling: `status` was a free string whose vocabulary lived only in this description, `type` was a free string absent from `required` even though it is the routing key the catalog publishes, and `identity_used` was declared here while `ProbeDeepReport` has no such field — schema fiction of the GAP-SCHEMA-FICTION-001 class. The inline `deep_research_budget` copy was also a stale 12-key subset behind `additionalProperties: true`; it now `$ref`s the single definition.

status.description: ok when the DOM carried result-page signal; captcha on a detected interstitial; error when the probe never reached a verdict.

endpoint.description: Endpoint that was probed (currently only html).

http_status.description: HTTP status code of the probe response (often 202 even when captcha is detected).

cascade_level.description: Cascade level reached during the probe (0..=4).

cascade_reason.description: Identifier of the failure mode (e.g., 'cloudflare_anomaly_modal', 'ddg_anomaly'). 'none' when no failure.

type.description: Envelope discriminator, published in the `schema` catalog so an agent can route mechanically.

body_len.description: Size of the rendered DOM the verdict was drawn from. Emitted by the Chrome path since GAP-WS-113; declared here in v1.0.3 because `additionalProperties: false` made the undeclared key invalidate the whole document.
